description: Changes the fields you send on a draft formation. Fails once the owner has signed.

add_ons.description: Add-on ids to include. `list_services` shows which can be added. Recurring ones can't: only the owner can start those.

agreement.description: Basic only: add the operating agreement or bylaws. Pro, Premium and Complete include them.

backup_name.description: A second choice, used if the state won't take the first.

contact.description: Who to reach about the order.

county.description: County, where publication depends on it.

designator.description: The ending, like `LLC`. `get_state` lists what the state accepts.

ein.description: Basic only: add the EIN. Pro, Premium and Complete include it.

expedite.description: Pay the state for faster processing, where it offers that.

management.description: LLCs only: run by its members or by managers.

members.description: LLC members, in states that charge per member.

name.description: The company name, without LLC or Inc.

owners.description: An LLC's members or a corporation's directors. The owner can also add these when they review the order.

par_value.description: Corporations only: par value in dollars. Empty for no par.

principal.description: The company's principal address. The owner can also add it when they review the order.

purpose.description: The business purpose. A nonprofit must state a specific one.

registered_agent.description: The registered agent the owner named.

shares.description: Corporations only: authorized shares, digits only.

state.description: The state to form in, two letters.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.
